title: 第四千二百一十九章 胶着第四千二百一十八章 玄剑气
content_zh:
下一刻，六道玄剑气排列成一条直线，骤然刺向八雷尊者！
在这六道玄剑气面前，空间消失，时间不在！
它跨越了时间与距离的束缚，仅仅一瞬间便出现在八雷尊者面前。
玄剑气展现出的这种速度，用快如闪电都远不足以来形容，它完全超越了某种规则的限制，能够无视时间与空间的阻碍。
察觉到即将触及眉心的六道玄剑气，八雷尊者顿时心中一凛。
此刻，在被这玄剑气锁定之下，他竟然生出了一种无法躲避的感觉。
不容他多想，下一刻，六道玄剑气直接刺入了他的灵体之中，狠狠的轰击在元神之上。
八雷尊者顿时感觉自己的脑中传来一阵滔天轰鸣，他的元神遭受了攻击，在止不住的摇曳，身躯也是骤然一僵。
玄剑气专门针对元神，面对这六道玄剑气，八雷尊者引以为傲的修为之力完全是无用武之地，只能以自身的元神去硬抗。
但他好歹也是一位实力强大的仙尊，元神无比的凝实与强大，以剑尘如今的境界所凝练的玄剑气，尽管威力十分惊人，但还不足以让他以仙帝九重天的境界伤到仙尊六重天的八雷尊者。
因此，这六道玄剑气，只是对八雷尊者造成了干扰，让他动作为之一顿。
然而就是这片刻的耽搁，使得他错失了对千魂魔尊打出毁灭一击的机会。
千魂魔尊抓住这短暂的一瞬，体内魔气疯狂涌动，施展急速直冲太初神殿的穹顶飞去，摆脱八雷尊者的雷霆力量干扰。
就在他即将撞击在顶部的天花板上时，太初神殿的力量出现，瞬间将千魂魔尊带走。
当八雷尊者稳固元神之后，恰好看到千魂魔尊消失的一幕，顿时气急败坏，暴跳如雷。
他当前所面对的两个对手中，剑尘有生命之源辅助，身上伤势恢复速度快的惊人，几乎就是打不死的存在，而千魂魔尊则成了他唯一能斩杀的目标。
结果眼下，连他唯一能杀之泄恨的目标也消失了，这自然让八雷尊者恨欲狂。
无奈之下，八雷尊者只好将目光转向剑尘。
可就在他刚看过去时，剑尘的身影同样消失不见。
顿时，太初神殿的第一层空间变得空荡起来，惟独八雷尊者一人孤零零的留在了这里。

“啊——，放老夫出去......”
八雷尊者发出怒吼，他身上的精气神在疯狂燃烧，裹挟着一股滔天之怒化作一条巨大的雷龙，闪电般轰击在太初神殿那紧闭的大门上。
只听得一声轰鸣巨响，漫天的雷灵之力炸开，八雷尊者的身躯被反弹的能量风暴震的接连倒退。
而太初神殿那紧闭的大门，却是依旧归然不动，毫发无伤。
毕竟是一件至尊神器，单凭材质本身的坚硬，就远不是八雷尊者所能伤到分毫。
之前他们几大强者在太初神殿内激烈交战，连同诸天神阵那堪比仙尊境七重天的毁灭攻击，都没有对太初神殿造成任何破坏。
八雷尊者显然也知道至尊神器的坚不可摧，但他显然不死心。接下来，他在低沉的咆哮声中，裹挟着燃烧自身精气神的伟岸力量，化作漫天雷海接连不断的对太初神殿的大门进行了数十次猛烈攻击。
顿时，震天的响声接连不断的传来，浩荡的雷霆力量疯狂肆虐，几乎将整个第一层空间都给填满。
在太初神殿内修行的那数十万紫霄剑宗弟子，此刻都明显的感觉出天地的震动。
一番疯狂的轰击后，八雷尊者终于停手了，他微微躬着身子站在那里喘着粗气，身上透着一股萎靡的气息。
能战到现在，他几乎全是凭燃烧自己的本源，消耗自身的精气神在苦苦支撑。
content_en:
The next moment, the six mysterious sword energies lined up in a straight line and suddenly stabbed at the Eight Thunder Lords!
In front of these six mysterious sword energies, space disappears and time disappears!
It transcended the constraints of time and distance and appeared in front of Lord Eight Thunders in just an instant.
The speed displayed by Xuanjian Qi cannot be described as fast as lightning. It completely transcends the limitations of certain rules and can ignore the obstacles of time and space.
Sensing the Six Paths Xuan Sword Qi that was about to touch his eyebrows, Lord Ba Lei suddenly felt a chill in his heart.
At this moment, being locked by this mysterious sword energy, he actually felt like he couldn't avoid it.
He was not allowed to think too much. The next moment, the six mysterious sword energy pierced directly into his spiritual body and violently bombarded his soul.
Lord Ba Lei suddenly felt a roar coming from his mind. His soul was under attack and was swaying uncontrollably, and his body suddenly stiffened.
The Xuanjian Qi specifically targets the Yuan Shen. Facing these six Xuanjian Qi, the power of cultivation that Master Ba Lei is proud of is completely useless, and he can only resist with his own Yuan Shen.
But after all, he is also a powerful Immortal Lord. His Yuanshen is incomparably solid and powerful. The Xuanjian Qi condensed by Jian Chen's current realm, although the power is very amazing, is not enough for him to hurt the Eight Thunder Lords of the Sixth Heavenly Immortal Emperor at the Immortal Emperor's ninth level.
Therefore, these Six Paths of Mysterious Sword Qi only caused interference to the Eight Thunder Masters, causing him to take action.
However, just this moment of delay caused him to miss the opportunity to deliver a devastating blow to the Thousand Soul Demon Lord.
Qianhun Demon Lord seized this brief moment, the demonic energy in his body surged crazily, and flew straight to the dome of Taichu Temple to get rid of the interference of Eight Thunder Lord's thunder power.
Just when he was about to hit the ceiling at the top, the power of Taichu Temple appeared and instantly took away the Thousand Souls Demon Lord.
After Master Ba Lei stabilized his soul, he happened to see the scene of Demon Master Thousand Souls disappearing, and he immediately became furious and became furious.
Among the two opponents he is currently facing, Jian Chen is assisted by the source of life and recovers from his injuries at an astonishingly fast rate, making him almost unbeatable, while the Thousand Soul Demon Lord has become the only target he can kill.
As a result, now, even the only target he could kill to vent his hatred has disappeared, which naturally makes Master Eight Thunders mad with hatred.
In desperation, Lord Ba Lei had no choice but to turn his attention to Jian Chen.
But just when he looked over, Jian Chen's figure also disappeared.
Suddenly, the first floor of the Taichu Temple became empty, with only Lord Ba Lei staying here alone.
"Ah——, let me out..."
Lord Ba Lei roared, and the energy in his body was burning crazily. With a surge of wrath, he turned into a huge thunder dragon and struck the closed door of Taichu Temple like lightning.
There was only a loud roar, and the power of thunder spirit exploded all over the sky. The body of Lord Eight Thunder was shaken by the rebounding energy storm and fell back one after another.
But the closed door of Taichu Temple remained motionless and unscathed.
After all, it is a supreme artifact, and based on the hardness of the material itself, it is far beyond the reach of the Eight Thunder Masters.
Several of their powerful men had fought fiercely in the Taichu Temple before, and even the destructive attack of the All-Heaven Divine Formation, which was comparable to the seventh heaven of the Immortal Realm, did not cause any damage to the Taichu Temple.
Master Ba Lei obviously also knew that the Supreme Artifact was indestructible, but he obviously did not give up. Next, with a deep roar, he carried the majestic power of burning his own energy and spirit, turned into a sea of ​​thunder and launched dozens of violent attacks on the gate of Taichu Temple one after another.
Suddenly, thundering sounds came one after another, and the mighty thunder power raged crazily, almost filling the entire first-level space.
The hundreds of thousands of Zixiao Sword Sect disciples practicing in Taichu Temple could clearly feel the shaking of heaven and earth at this moment.move.
After some crazy bombardment, Lord Ba Lei finally stopped. He stood there with a slight bow, breathing heavily, with a sense of malaise on his body.
To be able to fight until now, he has been able to support himself almost entirely by burning his own origin and consuming his own energy and spirit.
